title: The Review Checklist
subtitle: Run your design against a checklist before you present it, and treat each finding as a question
motto: Find the gaps yourself before the interviewer does
keyInsight: A design that looks complete can still fire several findings, and patching a high finding by adding a box can create a new one, so fix by severity and justify each addition rather than silence the rule.

decisions.title: Rules as one-line predicates
decisions.description: Each check is a short function over the design with a severity, so every finding can be traced to the exact condition that fired it.
decisions.alternatives: A free-form score would not tell the reader what to fix.

decisions.title: Re-run after patching the high findings
decisions.description: The last frame applies the obvious fixes and lints again, showing that adding a cache creates a cache-invalidation finding.
decisions.alternatives: Stopping at the first findings would imply that fixing each one in isolation is enough.
